name: dbt-agents
description: Policy-enforced tools for reviewing, querying, testing, and safely changing dbt projects and their warehouses.

interface.longDescription: Review dbt projects, inspect lineage and readiness, run bounded read-only warehouse queries, compile and test selected resources, and apply guarded repository or dbt changes through explicit plans and approvals. Internal access is limited to approved accounts and configured project boundaries.
capabilities: Plan and execute guarded dbt changes
defaultPrompt: List the dbt projects I can access and summarize their readiness.
Inspect this dbt project and explain its model lineage.
Estimate and run a bounded read-only warehouse query.
